newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro downgraded.

text.p: Caspian Research said on Tuesday it had downgraded Grupo Radio Centro's shares to market performer from buy.
-- It said it was lowering its recommendation on the grounds that the company "will enter a period of more gradual growth over the next four quarters."
-- Caspian said the more gradual growth is due mainly to the end of election campaigns, and lower advertising fees from telephone companies and pension funds (AFORE).
-- Radio Centro's shares in Mexico stood at 13.10 pesos, down 0.10 peso from Monday's close. The company's shares in New York were down 1/4 in midday trading at 15.
